items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Fintel: Mizuho upgraded ALB to Outperform on Oct 14. Barclays initiated at Equal-Weight Oct 13, Argus Buy Oct 7, UBS Buy Oct 5.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage - BESS - demand has tipped the market balance into a favorable territory, the analyst tells investors in a research note.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: ALB, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs. Q3/Q4 EPS estimates cut 13%/36% since Q2; Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Supply and demand trends in the lithium market appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating; lowering lithium company targets following spot price weakness, still views group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market on strong EV and stationary storage demand with supply lagging; maintained 2026 outlook, expecting high end of scenario ranges.
